blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — A member of the Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit (Cafgu) was killed while two others were wounded in a shooting in Polomolok, South Cotabato, on Monday morning. Police identified the victim as Jerald Calayo Flungcay, 23, a resident of Barangay Lapu, Polomolok, and assigned in Tboli town.
